matrixSpecAndSummary.title: Business Requirement -> Test Scenario -> Test Case -> Test Data
matrixSpecAndSummary.caveats.item: Element counts reflect the QE-shaped OUTPUT (test_generation/qe_shaped_test_data.py) — composite/merged/repeating field folding collapses several spec fields into one output key, so counts here are LOWER than the raw spec field count composer.py originally filled.

caveats: LLM bridge was unavailable for every scenario/requirement generation run this session — zero items passed through real Independent AI Review (the Judge). Every 'flagged_for_review' count below reflects 'unverified by AI', not 'AI-reviewed and flagged'. Human review carries the full weight until the bridge is available and a real pass is run.

Requirement Derivation produced 0 llm_phrased requirements — elements whose only documented rule is narrative (processing_rules text, not a clean length/enum pattern) never got a requirement at all, so they can never produce a scenario or test case either. This is an unquantified coverage ceiling below the element level.
Parameter Coverage (secondary metric) is a disclosed simplification — see reporting/coverage.py's docstring — not textbook pairwise-pair coverage.
Scenario.requirement_id is anchor-only (the first parameter's requirement for multi-parameter scenarios) — traceability rows for those scenarios undercount their true requirement breadth.

The approved test cases below may include a small dev/demo sample approved via tools/approve_sample_batch.py to exercise the pipeline end-to-end — that is NOT a real SME-reviewed batch. Check test_generation/audit_log.jsonl `reviewed_by` values before reporting approval numbers to stakeholders.

scenario_coverage.formula: approved scenarios with >=1 generated test case / total approved scenarios x 100
scenario_coverage.measures: pipeline yield only — NOT suite adequacy or executability

parameter_coverage.formula: SIMPLIFIED (see module docstring) — distinct parameter=value tokens covered / proposed

executable_readiness.formula: test cases with non-filler data AND >=1 ASSERT-tier expectation / total

filler_data_only.note: every populated field is repeated-character filler — not executable as-is

flow_coverage.note: an uncovered flow usually means a step's transaction has no assembled message template
